findings.f2_the_real_second_pass_is_p2b: configure_rlm_identity (create.rs:487 area) calls persisted_rlm_max_depth (agent_engine.rs:1693): FULL read_to_string + parse_session_entries of the session file to find the LAST rlm_max_depth_state custom row (.rev().find_map), usually absent (10/10 stock trials present=false) - the entire full-file read+parse is discarded work on the create critical path (create handler thread, before the background build).
findings.f3_p3_p4_double_warm_reread: adopt_built_session opens WindowedSessionStore twice back-to-back: persisted_goal_state (P3; only snapshot.goal is consumed - the entire retained-suffix re-read + full FileEntry re-parse is discarded) then the adoption open (P4). On the no-boundary stock fixture each open re-reads + re-parses the WHOLE file (snapshot.start ~= header end); on compacted classes each pays only the retained-suffix cost.
findings.f4_read_amplification: worker reads ~31.5MB for a 10.49MB fixture on one cold open (3 full passes + small reads); the retained corpus is FileEntry-parsed 3x (P1 walk + P3 + P4) plus SessionEntry-parsed once (P1's store build) plus parse_session_entries once (P2b).

candidate_scoping_no_edit.c1_p3_p4_shared_open: share ONE windowed open between the goal seed and the adoption (open once, goal_state() from the same window, restore_windowed_context on the same window). Parity: the goal comes from snapshot.goal of a generation-certified snapshot of the same bytes (within the same build, no writes between); fallback chain preserved: no-window => ONE SessionFile::open serving both the goal branch-scan and branch_file_entries (currently TWO full parses). Expected: -50.2ms stock / -6.8 tail1024 / -3.2 tail512 / -0.7 tail100 (P3's entire wall). Golden tests: differential oracle (shared-open goal == reference persisted_goal_state over fixture classes incl. malformed rows) + goal persistence/recovery flow test (create -> goal.create -> kill worker -> revive -> rehydrate assert).
candidate_scoping_no_edit.c2_p2b_store_backed_lookup: persisted_rlm_max_depth re-reads + re-parses the file although the create flow ALREADY holds the fully-loaded store (core.store, SessionEntry rows, same post-append rows as disk). Candidate: compute the depth-bound override from the in-memory store (entries().rev() with the same custom/customType/maxDepth-u64 predicate - the same mapping persisted_goal_state's fallback already uses on SessionEntry), pass it into configure_rlm_identity; the disk-read function stays as the differential-oracle reference. Expected: -34.5ms stock / -60-66ms compacted-pad-inflated / ~-50-60ms real-fixture estimate. Golden test: differential oracle over fixture classes (row present, absent, malformed, torn tail) vs the reference implementation.
